text: A raw pointer (T*) is non-owning; do not OWN a resource through a raw pointer — use a smart pointer / RAII for ownership.
Avoid trivial getters and setters — an accessor that only returns or assigns a member, adding no value.
A function should perform a single logical operation; avoid functions that do several unrelated things.
Prefer the standard library to hand-crafted code; use standard algorithms instead of reimplementing them with raw loops.
Make a function a member only if it needs the representation; a member function using no instance state should be static or free.
A base class destructor should be either public and virtual, or protected and non-virtual.
